## Synopsis

A field that the draft and live state both changed to different values needs a pick:
--pick "App/demo-tools straza.limits.rps=draft" keeps the draft's value, and =live takes live's.
A Check again with no pick decides nothing, so under admin.secondPerson it does not make you an
author of the draft.

```
strazactl drafts rebase <id> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --json               print the server's JSON answer, indented, and nothing else on stdout
      --pick stringArray   the value to keep for a field both sides changed, as "Kind/Name field=draft" or "Kind/Name field=live"; repeatable
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
